invariants.rationale: Indices into arrays are always non-negative, and 'i' starts at 0.
'result' is the first 'i' such that currentTime <= animationInterval, so it will be within array bounds.
'result' is returned when currentTime <= animationInterval for the interval at index 'result'.
Animation intervals typically represent durations and should be positive.
If the array were empty, the exception would always be thrown; so, for this code to return, length > 0.

meta.value: must have at least one interval
